title: Real-World Enterprise Case Studies: Endpoint Security & Incident Response

caseStudies.title: Case Study 1: Ransomware Containment at Regional Hospital Network
caseStudies.problem: Ransomware outbreak targeted electronic health records (EHR), threatening HIPAA compliance and patient care delivery.
solution: Deployed EDR agents across all workstation and medical device endpoints
Enabled behavioral ransomware detection with automatic host isolation (<3 seconds)
Configured BitLocker XTS-AES 256-bit encryption with recovery keys backed up to Azure AD
Enforced strict USB device control policies to block unauthorized flash drives
outcomes: Blocked active ransomware during early file encryption phase
Zero patient data lost; 100% HIPAA audit compliance maintained
Automated isolation limited lateral blast radius to exactly 1 endpoint

caseStudies.title: Case Study 2: APT Detection & Lateral Movement Block at Global Bank
caseStudies.problem: Nation-state APT group attempted stealthy credential dumping and lateral movement via encoded PowerShell scripts.
solution: SOC analysts flagged anomalous encoded PowerShell execution in EDR timeline
Traced process execution tree back to compromised web server entrypoint
Correlated telemetry with threat intelligence IOC database to identify APT actor
Simultaneously contained all 12 compromised endpoints via automated SOAR workflow
outcomes: Detected APT in 3 days (vs. 200+ days industry average)
Prevented estimated $50M+ financial data breach & regulatory penalties
Zero data exfiltration across all 10,000+ global banking endpoints

caseStudies.title: Case Study 3: Zero-Trust Endpoint Compliance for Global SaaS Workforce
caseStudies.problem: Remote employees accessing cloud production infrastructure from personal and unmanaged laptops.
solution: Mandated Intune device enrollment for all remote employee laptops
Configured Azure AD Conditional Access policy: Block logins unless device passes EPP/EDR compliance check
Enforced automated OS patch verification and full-disk BitLocker compliance
outcomes: Achieved 100% endpoint compliance visibility across 30 countries
Blocked non-compliant logins automatically without IT admin manual intervention
Passed SOC 2 Type II audit with zero unmanaged endpoint findings
